result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a misplaced dark horizontal bar appears inside the bottom navigation tab bar, making the navigation look visually broken.

issues.description: A thick dark grey horizontal bar is rendered inside the bottom navigation bar, positioned between the Search and Orders/Receipt tab icons. It looks like a misplaced active-state indicator, divider, or system gesture bar overlapping the tab bar, which disrupts the visual layout and may confuse users about which tab is selected.
issues.suggestion: Remove or correctly reposition the bar so it only indicates the active tab (e.g., a small pill directly under the selected icon) or, if it is the system home gesture bar, render it at the very bottom edge with proper safe-area insets so it does not overlap the tab bar icons.
